name: Currency Exchange 26
definition: Set of elements used to provide details of the currency exchange.

UnitCurrency.name: Unit Currency
UnitCurrency.definition: Currency in which the rate of exchange is expressed in a currency exchange. In the example GBP 1.00 = USD 1.30, the unit currency is GBP.

QuotedCurrency.name: Quoted Currency
QuotedCurrency.definition: Currency into which the base (unit) currency is converted. In the example GBP 1.00 = USD 1.30, the unit currency is USD.

PreAgreedExchangeRate.name: Pre Agreed Exchange Rate
PreAgreedExchangeRate.definition: The value of one currency expressed in relation to another currency. ExchangeRate|expresses the ratio between UnitCurrency and QuotedCurrency. (Amount in UnitCurrency * ExchangeRate = Amount in QuotedCurrency)

QuotationDateTime.name: Quotation Date Time
QuotationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which an exchange rate is quoted.

QuoteIdentification.name: Quote Identification
QuoteIdentification.definition: Unique identification to unambiguously identify the quote issued by the ForeignExchangeAgent.||Usage: This identification must be passed on throughout the entire end-to-end chain.

ForeignExchangeAgent.name: Foreign Exchange Agent
ForeignExchangeAgent.definition: Agent who undertakes the conversion of funds from the unit currency to the quoted currency.||Usage: The ForeignExchangeAgent must receive the AgreedRate block unchanged.
